Coordinate orchestration flows without creating a hub

Coordination services combine a small number of orchestration capabilities at a deliberate higher layer. The rules keep that scope legible and make excessive dependency growth visible before the class becomes an application-wide junction.

The value of enforcing this family

A recognisable coordination layer preserves flow-forward architecture as business processes become broader.
